name: resume_chapter
description: End this aside and restart the chapter. Call it first, with nothing said before it; its reply asks for your short lead-in, and the chapter starts when you finish saying it. Leave rewind out unless the listener seemed lost (then 'paragraph'): the page picks the restart point from how long the aside lasted.

reason.description: Why you are going back: the listener asked to (listener), a closing signal after your answer (closing), silence (silence), they said never mind (never_mind), anything else (other).

rewind.description: Optional. Where to restart: the interrupted sentence, one sentence earlier, or the start of the paragraph. Only 'paragraph', and only when the listener seemed lost.

name: save_seed
description: Record a topic for a future chapter, when a question deserves real research beyond this chapter's dossier. Say that it's worth a proper look; you cannot research it now.

topic.description: The topic, as a chapter could take it on, in a sentence.

why.description: Why it matters to the listener, in their own words where possible.
